phases.title: Fix favouriteController: remove inline 404 response, propagate ProductNotFoundError via next(err)
phases.notes: Removed inline ProductNotFoundError catch that called res.status(404).json(); now all errors propagate via next(err). Also removed unused import. Build passes, favouriteController test passes.

phases.title: Fix compareController: change next() to next(_err) so the error reaches the error handler
phases.notes: Changed next() to next(_err) in the catch block so errors propagate to the error handler. All 22 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Fix rateLimiter: replace new Error(...) with new RateLimitError(retryAfter) so the handler sets Retry-After and returns 429
phases.notes: Imported RateLimitError and replaced new Error(...) with new RateLimitError(retryAfter). All 22 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Run pnpm test and verify all tests pass
phases.notes: All 22 tests pass across 2 test files. Build (tsc) succeeds with no errors.
